character_facts: The octocyborg is an infiltration-capable being associated with stealth and penetration of defended spaces.
The priestess figures act collectively rather than individually, pooling their mental essence for attack.
The guards are conventional armed defenders and are vulnerable to the attackers' mental assault.
characters_present: Priestess-like women described as prostitutes/priestesses in the narration
At least one bulky white-glowing infiltrator or armored figure traveling in the beam
continuity_links: This page depicts the next stage of an infiltration: after evading external defenses, the attackers are now inside the fortress and neutralizing resistance.
dialogue_meaning: The narration says the infiltrator evades the fortress's guardian surveillance and penetrates the base.
The narration says the priestess group merges its mental force to eliminate the guards.
A guard cries out in pain or alarm during the attack.
A large sound effect marks an explosive, gory impact.
locations: Outer space above a pyramid-like stronghold
Interior corridors or chambers of the stronghold
lore_facts: The stronghold is protected by guardian satellites or similar detection systems.
The octocyborg is capable of bypassing those defenses and entering the stronghold.
The infiltrating group includes priestess figures with collective mental or psychic attack capability.
Their combined psychic force is lethal enough to exterminate armed guards quickly.
plot_events: An octopus-like cyborg infiltrates a fortified stronghold without being detected by its orbital or external defenses.
A beam from outside reaches into the fortress interior, delivering or guiding the infiltrators inside.
The intruders encounter armed guards in a metallic corridor.
A group of priestess-like women combine their mental power to kill the guards.
The defending guards are overwhelmed almost immediately, with at least one violently dismembered.
uncertainties: Some caption text is small and slightly blurred; wording is readable only approximately.
The exact identity of the glowing white infiltrator figures besides the priestess group is unclear from this page alone.
It is not fully clear whether the beam is transporting the intruders, projecting them, or serving as an entry path.
visual_summary: A reddish octopus-like cyborg organism hovers in space above a sharp, pyramid-like fortress and sends a narrow beam down into the structure. Inside the metallic corridors, glowing white figures arrive or advance through the beam while black-armored guards react. In the final panel, several pale, luminous priestess-like women stand behind the intruders as one guard is blown apart in a burst of blood and debris and another falls, showing a sudden psychic or energy assault.
